'''December 2000 Boxboro tournament (Jabba's Palace sealed)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boxborough, MA on 10 December 2000. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1542">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-12-father-william-in-boxboro-12-10-2000d1542/ father-william-in-boxboro-12-10-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 12 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-12-father-william-in-boxboro-12-10-2000d1542/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[December 2000 Boxboro tournament (constructed)]].

* '''Date:''' 10 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Boxborough, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (format)]]
